data.one_liner: A Flutter widget that conditionally wraps a child subtree with a parent widget.
data.what_it_does: Provides a WidgetWrapper component that evaluates conditions inside a wrapper function to decide whether to wrap a child widget or return it unwrapped. It simplifies conditional UI structures without verbose if-else statements.
use_when: You need to apply a parent widget conditionally based on a boolean flag.
You want to apply a wrapper only when a nullable value is present.
avoid_when: You are managing complex app state or navigation.
You prefer standard if-else widget creation directly in the build method.
strengths: Lightweight with no external dependencies other than Flutter
weaknesses: Does very little that cannot be achieved with standard Dart if-else expressions
API has breaking changes across major versions
data.minimal_example:
WidgetWrapper(
  wrapper: (child) => _condition
      ? ParentWidget(child: child)
      : child,
  child: ChildSubtree(),
)
